prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 3:4 medium-full athletic swimwear editorial of an adult East Asian woman standing waist-deep in a sunny upscale resort pool. She has a shoulder-length platinum-blonde bob with soft bangs and wears a glossy two-tone competitive one-piece swimsuit with a bubblegum-pink center panel and sunny-yellow side panels. Her wet hair and light water droplets suggest recent swimming; she lifts her face gently toward the sunlight in a relaxed pose. Include sparkling blue pool water and tiles, white lounge chairs, hedges, palm trees, and a Mediterranean-style villa. Use bright high-key midday sun, clean water reflections, sharp natural detail, and a non-sexualized athletic resort mood. Apply a swimsuit logo only if an approved logo reference is attached. No other text or watermark.
